verdict.rationale: Inngest documents a public REST API at api-docs.inngest.com for working with events, function runs, environments and more programmatically. A documented CLI and an official MCP server add further programmatic and agent-driven control surfaces. The probe found no OpenAPI spec at the candidate paths on www.inngest.com, but that is not a contradiction of the documented API. Missing for 10: detail on API coverage and authentication, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration of using the API.
